description: Team of UNSW engineering students in Sydney. Grayson (Mechatronic / Robotic Engineering) is passionate about closing the bridge between space and learning and building technical applications with real-world impact. Shelley (Mechanical / Biomedical Engineering) is a research assistant applying CNNs to terahertz imaging data, and is passionate about bridging real-world experiences with emerging technology to solve practical problems. Together, we tackle the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge.
